chapters.label: Live: Guatemala 2000
chapters.text: Guatemala City, 2000. The Futsal World Cup semi final: Spain against Russia. Daniel scores. Two one! Russia equalise. With fifty five seconds left, Daniel scores again! Three two, and Spain go on to become world champions.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How does Daniel escape a defender? Watch how he does it. The defender rushes in. Daniel puts his sole on the ball and drags it back. The defender misses, and Daniel turns away.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. When a defender gets close, step on the ball, pull it back with your sole, and turn away.
